1. (Currently amended) A system for identifying malicious threats on a network comprising: a computing device including a processor coupled to a system memory, the system memory storing instructions for execution on the processor, the instructions configured to cause the processor to: retrieve a network data associated with at least one of an IP address or a domain __from a network source external to the computing device__; analyze the network data __using a machine learning model trained on historical threat data__ and identify a malicious network threat; and perform a mitigating action to neutralize the malicious network threat __by modifying network infrastructure configurations__.

2. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the network data is retrieved from an edge router, wherein the network data comprises a snapshot of traffic being routed through the edge router __and wherein the snapshot is captured at a specific temporal interval__.

3. (Currently amended) The system of claim 2, further comprising a traffic measurement aggregator module logically connected to an edge router interface, wherein the network data further comprises at least one of an amount of data transceived by the edge router or a rate of data transceived by the edge router __and wherein the aggregator module performs real-time statistical analysis of the transceived data__.

4. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the network data comprises data from a border gateway protocol table associated with a primary computer network's connectivity relationships with at least one secondary network __and wherein the system analyzes routing path anomalies in the border gateway protocol data__.

5. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the instructions are further configured to cause the processor to push a notification including the mitigating action for the malicious network threat to a third party device __only after the risk score exceeds a predetermined threshold__.

6. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the instructions are further configured to cause the processor to: normalize the network data to a standard format; decorate the network data with at least one tag that identifies the network activity data; store the network data in a database; weight the network data according to a threat associated with the data __using a weighted scoring algorithm that incorporates multiple threat indicators__; and generate a risk score for the weighted data __that is dynamically adjusted based on temporal patterns__.

7. (Currently amended) The system of claim 6, wherein the instructions are further configured to cause the processor to generate the risk score by: compare a new activity at the IP address or the domain to a past activity at the IP address or the domain __using statistical deviation analysis__; determine whether the new activity fits a profile for a malicious IP address or domain __by applying behavioral pattern matching algorithms__; correlate the risk score with a previous malicious threat __using threat intelligence databases__; and adjust the risk score according to the correlation __with weighted confidence levels__.

8. (Currently amended) The system of claim 7, wherein the instructions are further configured to cause the processor to predict a network based attack according at least the risk score __by forecasting attack vectors based on identified threat patterns__.

9. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the mitigating action comprises at least one of a null routing the malicious network threat, adjusting an access control list (ACL) to block the malicious network threat, publishing a list identifying a bad actor committing the malicious network threat, or logically separating the IP address or domain from a network __and wherein the mitigating action is executed automatically upon threat confirmation__.

10. 11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 10, wherein the network data is retrieved from an edge router, wherein the network data comprises a snapshot of traffic being routed through the edge router __and wherein the snapshot is captured at a specific temporal interval__.

12. 13.
